WITH tgt AS (SELECT annual_sales_target, annual_sales_target_currency FROM contracts WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 1), sales AS (SELECT SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS confirmed_sales, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue') SELECT tgt.annual_sales_target, tgt.annual_sales_target_currency, sales.confirmed_sales, sales.fact_count, CASE WHEN NOT tgt.annual_sales_target IS NULL AND NOT sales.confirmed_sales IS NULL THEN ROUND(CAST((sales.confirmed_sales / NULLIF(CAST((tgt.annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) END AS completion_pct FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy LEFT JOIN tgt ON TRUE LEFT JOIN sales ON TRUE

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start, period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' AND NOT period_start IS NULL ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), rev AS (SELECT rf.period_start, rf.period_end, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS confirmed_revenue FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN periods AS p ON rf.period_start = p.period_start AND rf.period_end = p.period_end WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY rf.period_start, rf.period_end), tgt AS (SELECT rf.period_start, rf.period_end, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS target_revenue FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN periods AS p ON rf.period_start = p.period_start AND rf.period_end = p.period_end WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue_target' GROUP BY rf.period_start, rf.period_end) SELECT rev.period_start, rev.period_end, rev.confirmed_revenue, tgt.target_revenue, CASE WHEN tgt.target_revenue > 0 THEN rev.confirmed_revenue / tgt.target_revenue END AS completion_ratio FROM rev LEFT JOIN tgt ON rev.period_start = tgt.period_start AND rev.period_end = tgt.period_end ORDER BY rev.period_start DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, period_start, period_end, reporting_period FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST, reporting_period DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en AS product_name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS stock_on_hand, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS units_sold, l.reporting_period, l.period_start, l.period_end FROM latest AS l JOIN report_facts AS f ON f.report_id = l.id AND f.status = 'confirmed' LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = f.product_id WHERE f.metric_key IN ('stock_on_hand', 'units_sold') GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name_en, l.reporting_period, l.period_start, l.period_end ORDER BY p.sku

WITH po AS (SELECT id, TO_CHAR(submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS ym FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01') SELECT COALESCE(p.category, 'Unknown') AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN po.ym = '2026-08' THEN i.line_total END) AS amount_2026_08, SUM(CASE WHEN po.ym = '2026-08' THEN i.quantity END) AS cases_2026_08, SUM(CASE WHEN po.ym = '2026-09' THEN i.line_total END) AS amount_2026_09, SUM(CASE WHEN po.ym = '2026-09' THEN i.quantity END) AS cases_2026_09 FROM po JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.category, 'Unknown') ORDER BY category LIMIT 100
